text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That wasn't too bad, but it's a shame I
didn't get
first...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What did you think of the race, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What did you think of the race, Trainer?
choice_data_list: トレーニングの成果は出ていたぞ！
トレーニングの成果は出ていたよ！
まだまだ改善点が多い
choice_data_list_en: There's still plenty of room for improvement.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hm. So it wasn't the best, but it shows
I'm
improving?
choice_data_list: トレーニングの成果は出ていたぞ！
トレーニングの成果は出ていたよ！
まだまだ改善点が多い
choice_data_list_en: There's still plenty of room for improvement.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
They do say that failure provides an
opportunity
to learn... Okay, I see. So
you're looking at all this
from a broader
perspective.
choice_data_list: ああ、この調子なら次は勝てる
うん、この調子なら次は勝てる
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, keep this up and you'll win next time.
Yeah, keep this up and you can win next time.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I knew you were the right person to train
me. I
feel like I can count on you to
make me much
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right! ♪ In celebration of our
achievement, I
hereby present you with
a clover of appreciation
and gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list_en: Hm? Do you still have it?
Hm? Do you still have it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to go find one! ♪ Would you
like to join
me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We search the parks on the way home
for a
four-leaf clover, and Fine Motion
ends up giving
me the prettiest one she
finds.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I bet you've noticed even more areas I
can
improve on than I have...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And what an excellent trainer you are!
Would you
mind explaining how I might
improve?
choice_data_list: 君のトレーナーだからな
貴方のトレーナーだからね
choice_data_list_en: Because I'm your Trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'll take everything you say onboard, so
please be
as strict as you want. Let's
start the breakdown
right away.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It's just like my father said. The
people most
worthy of trust and respect
are those willing to give
honest
criticism...
choice_data_list: ああ、まずは序盤の展開から――
うん、まずは序盤の展開から――
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, let's start with how the early race unfoldsâ
Yeah, starting with how the early race unfolds—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion whispers those words to
herself as
she faces the review session
with a resolute look
in her eye.
